description: Generate complete IPC boilerplate for a new feature: ipcMain handler in the main process, preload bridge function with contextBridge, TypeScript type declarations, and renderer-side usage example. Produces all the files needed for a secure, type-safe IPC channel.

apiNamespace.description: The namespace on window.electronAPI to group this under, e.g. 'users', 'settings'. Defaults to 'api'.

args.description: TypeScript type for the arguments, e.g. '{ userId: string }' or 'string'. Omit for no arguments.

description.description: What this IPC channel does, e.g. 'Fetches user profile from the database'

returnType.description: TypeScript type for the return value (renderer-to-main only), e.g. '{ name: string; email: string }'. Omit for void.

name: electron_scaffold_ipc_channel
